title: Monthly tradesmen's Mass and adoration
location: Saint Mary of Victories, St. Louis
summary: Mass offered for the Guild and its members, followed by adoration. Open to all.
body: A monthly Mass with tradesmen and their families in mind, followed by adoration. Fr. Michael Novak celebrates. Coffee in the parish hall after. Spiritual direction is available by arrangement.

title: Formation meeting: Catholic business ethics
location: Saint Mary of Victories, St. Louis
summary: Monthly formation meeting for members. Catholic business ethics and time to strengthen bonds between members.
body: Members meet monthly for formation in Catholic business ethics and to look after each other's work. This month: pricing honestly when a customer cannot pay. Guests are welcome with a member.

title: Parish repair day
location: Saint Mary of Victories, St. Louis
summary: A Guild work day at the parish. Members bring tools; the church brings the punch list.
body: Guild members give a day of labor to the parish. Past repair days have cleared the parking lot, repaired a leaking window, installed a new toilet, and set up the commercial coffee system. This year: tuckpointing the north wall, gutter cleaning, and painting the hall. Coffee at 7:30, work at 8.

title: Guild Christmas party
location: Parish hall, Saint Mary of Victories
summary: Dinner, carols, and a visit from St. Nicholas for the kids. Members, families, and friends of the Guild.
body: Dinner, carols, and a visit from St. Nicholas for the kids. Families and friends of the Guild are welcome. $15 a person, children free. Bring a dish if you can.

title: Annual tradesmen's retreat
location: A retreat house outside St. Louis
summary: A weekend retreat for Guild members. Donors at the Foreman level and above are invited.
body: The Guild's annual retreat for members, Friday evening to Sunday noon. Conferences, confession, silence, and time with the men. $180 a man, and help is available for anyone who needs it. Foreman and Master level donors receive an invitation.

title: St. Joseph the Worker Holy Day procession
location: Saint Mary of Victories, St. Louis
summary: The Guild's annual procession on the feast of St. Joseph the Worker. Open to all.
body: Members and families process from the church on the feast of our patron, May 1. Gather at the church at 6:00 PM. We walk the neighborhood with the statue of St. Joseph and return for Benediction. Everyone is welcome to walk with us; strollers are fine.
